lines.en: I run with my belly near the grass.

lines.zh: 草甸上的石头，我一步就跳过。
lines.en: One hop clears the meadow stones.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，耳朵一直在转。
lines.en: I stop and go, ears always turning.
The slope is steep; I go sideways.

lines.zh: 前面有鹰的影子，我立刻蹲下。
lines.en: A hawk's shadow — I drop flat.
I trundle along, heavy-bodied.
My burrow is just ahead.
I sniff as I walk.
My claws dig at grass roots.
I glance back for my group.

lines.zh: 草地太晒，我贴着阴影走。
lines.en: Too bright; I keep to the shade.

lines.zh: 走两步我就立起来看一眼。
lines.en: Two steps, then I stand to look.
I stand upright and look far off.
The wind stirs all my fur.

lines.zh: 肚子饿了，可是不敢走远。
lines.en: Hungry, but I dare not wander far.
I fold my forepaws to my chest.
Dandelions here are sweet.
My shadow is short. Noon.
My group naps by the burrow.
I grind my front teeth.

lines.zh: 地上有块石头，正好当哨位。
lines.en: A stone here makes a good lookout.
I hear the grass rustle.
This burrow was not mine.

lines.zh: 太阳把我的肚子烤暖了。
lines.en: The sun warms my belly.

lines.zh: 远处的石头看起来像人。
lines.en: That rock looks like a person.
Do you smell of hawk?
Up, then down again.
Let us keep our distance.
You are near my burrow.
I tilt my head. Not reassured.
Would you dig up my burrow?
Your boots are enormous.
I dislike being stared at.
I duck behind a stone.
I shriek and bolt for the burrow.
A tuft of fur is torn out.
I am trembling.
I will lick this better.
I inch back to the burrow.
Do not come again.
Squeak — I have to get back to the burrow.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我缩进草甸的洞。
lines.en: One hit and I dive into my meadow burrow.
Is that dandelion?

lines.zh: 这味太香了，我站不住了。
lines.en: That smell undoes my caution.
I sniff first. No rushing.
Put it down and I will come.
One bite of this lasts all morning.
My group can have some too.
I will not come near your hand.
I snatch a piece and bolt.
A leaf more, please.
I am softer than you think.
I shrink toward the burrow.

lines.zh: 两个人挤一块石头，不够。
lines.en: Two of us, one stone. Not enough.
I squeak twice.
Your foot is like a pillar.
I give half my width.
That was not a fight.
You stepped on my burrow!
Spring is the time for that.
I must tidy the burrow first.
We winter together.
I line the nest with grass.
Let me see if you are well fed.
The whole group has a say.
I am shy. I turn away.
Slowly.
I am on watch.
Good leaf. Nest lining.
Carrying it, I run slower.
I stuff it into my cheeks.
I dig the soil aside first.
This stone is beyond me.
Drop it and fetch it again.
I drag it to the burrow.
Today's harvest.
Do not take it. I worked for it.
My fur bristles.
I give a sharp cry.
I stand before the burrow.
I cannot beat you, but I will bite.
All of you, back off.
My teeth are yellow and hard.

lines.zh: 我后腿绷紧，随时能钻洞。
lines.en: My haunches are cocked; I can bolt to the burrow.
This is my last warning.
Small as I am, I bite.
One ear on you, one on my burrow.
When your foot lifts, I run.
My burrow is behind me.
I called. My group will come.
Too close.
I am not afraid, and not foolish.
One step more and I bite.
Think it through.
I rake your instep.
A small bite, but it stings.
I lunge once and retreat.
I go for your fingers.
Your hide is too tough.

lines.zh: 这一下用了我全部力气。
lines.en: That was all my strength.
I bolt for the burrow.
Do not follow.
I poke my head from the burrow.
Wind on the meadow. Good.
I scan the area first.
Dandelions here.
My group is close by.
The soil at the burrow is fresh.
The sun is not yet high.

lines.zh: 我立起来，看看有没有鹰。
lines.en: I stand to check for hawks.
This is good grass.
I crawl out slowly.
Someone walks in the distance.

lines.zh: 草烧起来，我的毛也焦了。
lines.en: The grass burns, and my fur with it.

lines.zh: 我从高处滚下来，摔得发晕。
lines.en: I tumble from height, dazed.
I should not have gone near water.

lines.zh: 我被气浪推得滚了几圈。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over and over.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我毛都竖起来。
lines.en: That force stands my fur on end.

lines.zh: 雷打在草上，我吓得钻土。
lines.en: Lightning hits the grass; I dive for soil.
No grass here, and no burrow.
